# Broken case packages (D2)

One package per spec §3.5 rule. Each is fixture-y with one thing wrong. They are generated by `tools/broken/build.ts`; regenerate with `pnpm fixtures`. `client/src/case/broken.test.ts` checks each one produces its message.

| Folder | What is wrong | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema/` | `title` missing; `entries[0].node` is a number | Rejected; errors at `/title` and `/entries/0/node` |
| `units/` | Every length in metres | Warning, fix: rescale ×1000 |
| `axes/` | Head–foot axis negated | Warning, fix: flip S |
| `graph/` | A zero-length edge; a target on an island | Edge removed; target `reachable: false` |
| `radii/` | `e_left` one radius short; `e_right` has a 0 mm radius | Both edges (and `plaque_r`) removed; case loads |
| `mesh_budget/` | 107,520 triangles | Warning, fix: decimate to 100,000 |
| `privacy/` (`case.zip`) | Placeholder patient fields in case.json, centerlines.json and the GLB's extras | Stripped; one notice naming the fields |
| `physics/` | A parametric case claiming `phantom3` | Planning only warning |

The values in `privacy/` are placeholders, not data.
